qa_accepted_variance.item: long tail after the last spoken word
qa_accepted_variance.status: APPROVED AS-IS by Steven - do not re-flag
qa_accepted_variance.finding: Voiceover ends at 15.82s, the earliest in the season, leaving about 3.7s of scene 3 running on the effects bed before the brand card. Tail after the last spoken word is 7.2s here versus 1.6-5.2s across the other eleven episodes, making this the outlier by about two seconds.
qa_accepted_variance.measurement: The stretch is NOT silence - the bed is audible throughout and peaks near -22.7 dBFS. The final 3s at -91 dBFS is the house-standard silent logo reveal and is present in every episode (verified on EP-001, 004, 007, 008, 011, 012).
qa_accepted_variance.decision: Steven listened to an isolated clip and judged it is not hurting anything. Leave the episode untouched and treat the longer tail as intentional. No re-render, no new media ids; existing EP-007 links remain valid.
